evidence.s1: Record's three-quantity table (source average, per-group declared level, drawn body median) for four phases x both schemes puts window bodies at 0.635-0.872 light and 0.164-0.324 dark with 0 of 13,656 gated lines under floor; the dark phase captures show the evening-print grade.
evidence.s2: At rest, three named units (the Now module left, the Places window centre, the Today window right) plus two ornaments, in fv light and dark.
evidence.s3: Now, Places and Today spans are 320/404/376 CSS px, thickness 8 recorded for all five surfaces, and the Search ornament's placeholder is judged by rendered contrast (4.81:1 dark).
evidence.s4: Viewport-fixed photograph canvas stays visible in the 63 px gutters, the sky band and the foreground band around all three windows in every phase capture, both schemes.
evidence.s5: Regular frost on all five surfaces in fv light/dark; record states no clear variant anywhere.
evidence.s6: No clear glass on the page (fv and menu captures, both schemes), so no undimmed clear surface exists.
evidence.s7: No tinted control: search, Photograph ornament and platter switches are neutral ink in menu light/dark; record 'tint: none'.
evidence.s8: Every surface carries the photograph's hue and structure through the material (dusk and day light) with no opaque fill; the forced-colours frame is drawn on a child, never the host.
evidence.s9: Windows fixed r32, Search and Photograph ornaments capsules, platter fixed r24, Places tiles and agenda row fixed/concentric radii (fv and menu light).
evidence.s10: Places corner tiles inset 20 at r12 (32-20) and platter thumbnails r6 inside their r12 selection ring read concentric; no pinched or flared corner (fv and menu light).
evidence.s11: Floating Search and Photograph ornaments are capsules; the dense Places tiles are rounded rectangles (fv light).
evidence.s12: No multi-item bar: the Search ornament holds only glyph and field, the Photograph ornament one control (fv light/dark).
evidence.s13: No glass mixes a text button with an icon button: the Photograph ornament is a single text-plus-chevron button, Search a field (fv light).
evidence.s14: Glass sits on the Search capsule and the Photograph button themselves; Places tiles and agenda rows are child fills, not glass (fv dark).
evidence.s15: Five same-material surfaces are held apart by the one derived 63 px gap and read as deliberately separate (fv light/dark).
evidence.s16: The Today window's child scroller clips agenda and tasks with top and bottom edge fades while the header, host and ornaments stay put (scroller-1 middle/bottom, light and dark).
evidence.s17: Every footprint sits over cloud, ridge, cumulus or star field in phases 1-4 light and dark, the dawn crop having moved the search off flat sky.
evidence.s18: Record: 0 of 13,656 gated readings under floor, worst 4.81:1 (Search placeholder, dark dawn); fv and phase captures read cleanly in both schemes.
evidence.s19: shot-reduced shows near-opaque frost with all content readable and the gaps widened; record logs an Increase Contrast plus Reduce Motion sweep with zero diagnostics and the Reduce Motion morph fix.
evidence.s20: Hosts carry no background, border or scrim; the dark grade is a full-plane tone curve on the photograph, not a footprint scrim (phase dark captures).
evidence.s21: The Photograph platter opens as a GlassMorph from its ornament (menu light/dark show it in the ornament's place); no opacity transition and runtime press, per record since motion is not in stills.
evidence.s22: Search glyph, ornament label, weather glyphs, checkboxes and switches are monochrome ink; colour lives only in the photograph and platter thumbnails (menu light).
evidence.s23: Control labels are dark ink on light bodies and light ink on dark bodies, never near the photograph's orange or blue behind them (fv and phase captures).
evidence.s24: The Now module is figures only; Places and Today lines are primary or 84% primary at medium weight, gated per line at worst 4.81:1; tertiary only on the forecast hairline (fv light, record).
evidence.s25: Lighter child fills mark the interactive Places tiles and the in-progress agenda row, with no nested hosts and no fill stacked on a fill (fv light/dark).
evidence.s26: Search (440 wide over the 494 Places) and the Photograph ornament (248 under the 320 Now) are overlay groups 63-64 px outside their unit by the derived gap, controls plain, no overlap (fv and menu light).
evidence.s27: The only images are platter thumbnails in opaque frames concentric with their selection ring (menu light); the Now module uses monochrome glyphs, not photographs.
evidence.s28: No colour accent; emphasis is weight and the whole lighter fill of the current agenda row (fv light).
evidence.s29: Now, Places and Today are untinted; identity comes from the Val d'Orcia photograph across phases 1-4.
evidence.s30: Record gives cssBody collapsed at 1440x900 @1/@2 and two-layer at 1024x768 @1 with host areas, both forms looked at; css-fv reads; shot-forced keeps Canvas panels with CanvasText frames and bordered tiles/row; span 320-500 extrapolation and 'not visionOS glass' stated.
